name: llm-gateway
idea: A proxy in front of several LLM providers with fallback, caching, and per-user cost limits.
requirements:
Route each request to the primary provider, and fall back to the secondary on errors.
Retry provider errors before falling back.
Cache identical prompts for 10 minutes.
Track spend per user and reject requests once a user's monthly budget is used.
Return the first token within 800 ms at p95.

history.title: Retry loop hung for 40 minutes
history.root_cause: Retries had no total deadline and the provider stalled
history.prevention: Every external call has a timeout, a retry cap, and backoff

history.title: Budget counter lost updates under load
history.root_cause: Read-modify-write on the counter without a lock
history.prevention: Shared counters change in one atomic update

history.title: Settings page buttons misaligned on Safari
history.root_cause: Never opened the page in Safari
history.prevention: Check layout in every supported browser

relevant: Budget counter lost updates under load
irrelevant: Settings page buttons misaligned on Safari

name: payments-webhooks
idea: Receive payment webhooks from the card processor, record payments, and email a daily summary.
requirements:
Accept webhook events for payment succeeded and refunded.
Store each payment once.
The processor retries a webhook until it gets a 2xx response.
Send each merchant a daily summary at 8am in the merchant's time zone.

history.title: Same webhook charged a customer twice
history.root_cause: Handler was not idempotent and the sender retried
history.prevention: Webhook handlers dedupe on the event id

history.title: Daily report sent at the wrong hour after the clocks changed
history.root_cause: Scheduled with a fixed UTC offset
history.prevention: Schedule in the user's zone, not a fixed offset

history.title: Avatar upload rejected large photos
history.root_cause: Upload limit lower than phone photo sizes
history.prevention: Test uploads with real-world file sizes

relevant: Same webhook charged a customer twice
Daily report sent at the wrong hour after the clocks changed

name: vendor-csv-import
idea: A nightly job that imports product files from vendors into the catalog.
requirements:
Download each vendor's CSV file every night.
Files can be several gigabytes.
Some vendors export from Excel.
Reject rows with a missing SKU and report them to the vendor.

history.title: Import crashed on a file with a byte order mark
history.root_cause: Header parse failed on the BOM from an Excel export
history.prevention: Parsers handle a BOM and other encodings

history.title: Import job ran out of memory on a large file
history.root_cause: Loaded the whole file into memory
history.prevention: Stream large files row by row

history.title: OAuth token refresh raced between two tabs
history.root_cause: Both tabs refreshed with the same refresh token

relevant: Import crashed on a file with a byte order mark
Import job ran out of memory on a large file
irrelevant: OAuth token refresh raced between two tabs

name: reminder-scheduler
idea: Send push reminders to users at 9am their local time, with retries.
requirements:
Each user picks reminder days.
Send at 9am in the user's local time.
Retry failed pushes up to three times.
The service runs as two instances behind a load balancer.

history.title: Cron job ran twice after a deploy
history.prevention: Exactly one instance owns scheduled jobs

history.title: Notifications shifted an hour at daylight saving
history.root_cause: Stored local times as UTC offsets
history.prevention: Store the time zone name, not the offset
